title: Weekly Product Changelog: October 12, 2026
summary: Added : Sunny can search the public roadmap and file or upvote a feature request for you, but only after you say go.
body_markdown:

[← Back to changelog](https://roadmap.sunsama.com/changelog)[Powered by Canny](https://canny.io/powered-by-canny?utm_source=changelog_subdomain&utm_medium=powered&utm_campaign=sunsama&company=Sunsama)


Added


:


- Sunny can search the public roadmap and file or upvote a feature request for you, but only after you say go. It leaves out personal or confidential details, and you can undo anything it posts right from the chat.
- Teach Sunny a standing rule in chat and it can save it for you, after repeating it back and checking with you first.
- Exported task data now includes backlog priority and daily priority.


Improved:


- Sunny is better at remembering the right things. It keeps durable facts about who you are, and no longer saves app questions, dated to-dos or one-off details from a single day.
- Gmail and Outlook previews show the sender's email address next to their name, making phishing easier to spot.
- Two-factor authentication is more secure.


Fixed


:


- @-mentions work in comments again, whether you click a teammate or press Enter.
- A repeating Apple Reminder you merged into another task as a subtask no longer reappears in the Reminders panel when it's set to "Hide once imported."
